title: Server Architecture of SigRepo Database
text: SigRepo_Server server half SigRepo, platform storing, sharing, comparing omic signatures. reproducible framework deploying SigRepo instance — locally Linux-based cloud host — interacting REST API, web interface, MCP server AI agents. client half SigRepo R package; signatures represented R6 objects defined OmicSignature, -house package.

title: Server Architecture of SigRepo Database
text: server set containerized services: MySQL database — initializes manages SigRepo schema, storing signatures, collections, users, controlled vocabularies (organisms, platforms, sample types, assay types), gene set resources. Per-signature differential-expression (difexp) tables held companion object store. Plumber REST API — single access path data. defines schema, loads reference tables, stores retrieves difexp objects, authenticates every call api_key, exposes analysis endpoints (signature comparison, enrichment) analysis runs server-side rather requiring users download whole signatures. Web interface — React single-page app, built static assets served nginx, also proxies /api API container browser talks single origin. replaced R Shiny dashboard, archived SigRepo_Server_Legacy. MCP server — Model Context Protocol endpoint lets AI agents search signatures, retrieve signature context, compare signatures, browse gene sets, run enrichment, grounded stored data. sits behind rate-limiting reverse proxy reachable https://sigrepo.org/mcp/. analyses exposed discrete API endpoints common signature representation, additional analysis engines external gene-set resources can added new endpoints without changing database schema.

title: Server Architecture of SigRepo Database
text: Beyond storage retrieval, API supports analysis stored signatures: Signature comparison — set signatures can compared feature overlap (Jaccard index Fisher exact tests), rank-based Kolmogorov–Smirnov statistics, GSEA, returning similarity matrices , GSEA, per-pair leading-edge data. Bi-directional signatures compared per matched group label. Gene set enrichment — -representation rank-based enrichment MSigDB via hypeR, MSigDB collections cached server-side.
